caption: The drawing features a rectangular yellow background with uneven, textured edges. Arranged diagonally across the center and spreading to the lower right and upper left corners, there is a composition of blue flowers with yellow centers and green leaves. The flowers vary in size and are connected by thin, curved green stems. The leaves are elongated and come to points, also showing some shading in darker and lighter green tones. The overall layout of the flowers and leaves appears natural and slightly curved, traversing the yellow field from the left side toward the right. The drawing is surrounded by a white border, and within the border at the bottom, the words "ACTUAL SIZE" and "FRANK MAURER" are printed in small, neat letters on the left and right sides, respectively.
title: Crewel embroidery
